title: Declare the minimum Rust version
why: Without rust-version, Cargo cannot reject unsupported compilers or apply MSRV-aware dependency resolution for the package.
suggestion: Set package.rust-version directly or inherit it from workspace.package.rust-version.
limitations: The rule checks declaration presence, including explicit workspace inheritance, but does not resolve or validate an inherited minimum or run the declared toolchain. Workspace defaults are not inherited without a member declaration.
Virtual workspaces, non-production manifests, and manifests that require unstable Cargo features are excluded. Private packages and pinned toolchains alone are not excluded.

Compiler-internal library plugins are excluded only when package.metadata.rust-analyzer.rustc_private is true and the available library crate root unconditionally enables feature(rustc_private). Conditional features, unavailable roots, binary targets, and other unstable compiler features are not inferred.
